summary: Phase 92 tested end-to-end (backend pytest via public URL + Playwright UI). Everything requested works: Income now requires a Work Order (400 from the API, toast in the UI), ensure_demo creates a DEMO Work Order and is idempotent, the milestone 'Mark Received' dialog shows the WO selector and stamps the WO on all 4 generated txns (income, candidate_recovery, assessment_fee, tds_deduction), and admin bulk-assign fills only empty fields (non-destructive) with a success toast. Bulk-assign returns 403 for company_admin and 401/403 when unauthenticated. KPIs did not regress (Total Deductions = Rs 1,29,741). No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: No check that the chosen work_order_id (or center_id/project_id) matches each row's center. Bulk-assigning a WO from center A onto a row from center B is accepted, but create_transaction rejects the same mismatch. Consider skipping or reporting mismatched rows.
Entity ids (company/partner/center/project) are not checked for existence before update_many. A bad id is written as-is.
Only work_order_id is saved. work_order_no is filled in at GET time, while milestone and bulk-assign rows store work_order_no. Storage is inconsistent but harmless.

issues: 2-col grid: Center sits alone on row 2 with an empty right cell, because Project is col-span-2. Consider Center+Project on one row and Work Order full width.
The WO dropdown shows both '— Auto (DEMO Work Order) —' and 'DEMO Work Order' when the center only has the demo WO. The duplicate is a bit confusing.

action_items: (Optional) Validate WO/center consistency per row in bulk-assign, or show a warning in the dialog when the selected rows span several centers.

(Optional) Fix the stale regression test tests/test_receive_idempotency.py. It seeds status='planned' but the endpoint now requires 'pending', so it fails with 400 for every call. This is a test-data issue, not a product regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~28.7k lines and Transactions.jsx is 1217 lines. Both are far over the 700-line guideline and should be split.
receive_batch_payment: WO validation runs after the idempotency lock and calls _rollback correctly. Verified that a wrong-center WO gives 400, the payment returns to pending, and 0 txns are created.
The frontend income/expense WO validation is skipped while editing (the !editing guard). Old income rows without a WO can still be edited, which is probably intentional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (milestone receive WO, income WO mandatory, bulk-assign only-empty, non-admin hidden)

seed_data_creation: Temporary data was seeded by test scripts and then cleaned up: TEST_ctr-*/TEST_batch-* fixtures, the TEST_ui92_batch with a pending 1st milestone at TEST_Center_Phase72, a milestone income txn, and a manual income txn. All of it is deleted. The DEMO Work Order 5d3b236b-71e7-46d0-93a9-ddd0ae0a1041 on TEST_Center_Phase72 was created earlier by the main agent and was kept.
test_credentials: admin@finance.app/Admin@123; companyadmin1@x.com/Test@1234. After login, company_admin lands on /select-company and then /hrms. /transactions redirects to /hrms because this tenant has no finance module, so the Assign button cannot appear by construction. The API-level 403 was verified.
